## Covariate Cleaning

#### Load libraries and data

`p0047_candle.csv` with data dictionary `p0047_data_dictionary.xlsx` was received from ECHO PATHWAYS data team on November 6th 2020 for sPTB placental transcriptome paper (PMID: 35868418) 

`p0109_data.csv` with data dictionary `p0109_data_dictionary.xlsx` was received from ECHO PATHWAYS data team on  September 27, 2023 for Placental Transcriptome and prenatal vitamin D analysis

`batch_one_miRs_20240718.Rds` Received from Jim MacDonald on 07/18/2024. **This is only half the data**. We will use this to generate batch information for the microRNAs.

`all_miRs_20240718.Rds` Received from Jim MacDonald on 07/18/2024. **This is the complete data**.

`candle_20200226.Rdata` Received from Jim MacDonald on September 28, 2023 for the vitamin D analysis

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  ## tidy data framework, ggplot2, pipes
library(assertthat) ## sanity checks
library(here)       ## sets path nicely for markdown
library(edgeR)      ## differential expression analysis; limma/voom dependencies
library(table1)     ## label functions works nicely with arsenal
library(arsenal)    ## nice table 1 functionality
library(coin)       ## need to run trend test with tableby (income variable)
library(kableExtra) ## print nice tables to HTML
library(ggrepel)    ## for repelling labels in volcano plots
library(ggtext)     ## for nicely formatted ggplot axis labels
library(igraph)     ## network stats

## covar from sPTB paper
p0047_candle <- read_csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/p0047_candle.csv")

## covar from vitamin D paper
p0109_data <- read_csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/p0109_data.csv")

## mRNA data
load("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/sPTB_PlacentalTranscriptome_CANDLE/RawData/candle_20200226.Rdata")
## loads annot, batches, candle_counts, candle_lengthScaledTPM and function fixCounts

## miRNA data
all_mirs <- readRDS("/Volumes/paquette_a/CANDLE_miRNA/RawData/all_mirs_20240718.Rds")

batch_one_mirs <- readRDS("/Volumes/paquette_a/CANDLE_miRNA/RawData/batch_one_mirs_20240718.Rds")
```

#### Filter by inclusion criteria

```{r}
## sanity check (make sure all 765 miRNA samples and all 794 mRNA samples match)
p0047_candle$pathways_id %in% colnames(as.data.frame(all_mirs)) |> sum()
p0047_candle$pathways_id %in% colnames(candle_counts$counts) |> sum()

## list IDs
ids_mRNA <- colnames(candle_counts$counts) |> unique()
ids_miRNA <- colnames(all_mirs)[-1] |> unique()

## confirm the size of the intersect, 765
ids_miRNA %in% ids_mRNA |> sum()

## keep ids
pathways_ids_to_keep <- ids_miRNA[ids_miRNA %in% ids_mRNA]

## generate a miRNA sequencing variable
miRNA_batches <- tibble::tibble(pathways_id = ids_miRNA) |>
  dplyr::mutate(mir_batch = dplyr::if_else(pathways_id %in% colnames(batch_one_mirs) == TRUE, 1, 2))
```

#### Filter by exclusion criteria

First, we will generate a simplified urinary cotinine variable.

```{r}
with(p0109_data, cor.test(cotinine_yn_m1, cotinine_yn_m2, method = "kendall"))

p0109_data$cotinine_ever_yes <- dplyr::case_when(
  p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m1 == 1 | p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m2 == 1 ~ 1, 
  p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m1 == 0 | p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m2 == 0 ~ 0,
  is.na(p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m1) == TRUE & is.na(p0109_data$cotinine_yn_m2) ~ NA
  )

summary(p0109_data$cotinine_ever_yes)
```

Now, generate the covariates. 

```{r}
covar <- p0047_candle |>
  ## filter to correct IDs
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% pathways_ids_to_keep) |>
  ## from 1503 to 765
  ## remove participants with placental abruption, preeclampsia, or chorioamnionitis or NA values
  dplyr::filter(m_chorio == "0" & h_placental_abrupt == "0" & m_preeclam == "0") |>
  ## from 765 to 753
  ## also other hypertension variables
  
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn == "0") |> ## Chronic HTN in current pregnancy at M1 (NA = 5)
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn2 == "0") |> ## Chronic HTN ever (NA = 5)
  dplyr::filter(ld_gesthtn4 == "0") |> ## PE or gHTN diagnosed since last visit at delivery (NA = 56)
  dplyr::filter(ld_cshtn == "0" | is.na(ld_cshtn) == TRUE) |> ## C-section indication: PE/HTN
  dplyr::filter(ld_mhtn == "0" | is.na(ld_mhtn) == TRUE) |> ## Delivery classifcation: PTB--PE/HTN
  ## From 753 to 691
  dplyr::filter(factor(labor_type) != "3") |> ## remove induced labors
  ## from 691 to 476
  ## regen bmi because weirdly lots of NAs despite the complete underlying variables
  dplyr::mutate(prepreg_bmi = prepreg_weight_kg /((m_height_cm/100)^2)) |>
  ## add in the miRNA batch; use left join to only match filtered data
  dplyr::left_join(miRNA_batches, by = join_by(pathways_id)) |>
  ## add in the miRNA batch; use left join to only match filtered data
  dplyr::left_join(p0109_data |> 
                     dplyr::select(pathways_id, zavg5_us_doc_dob_wght, cotinine_ever_yes) |> 
                     na.omit()) |>
   dplyr::mutate(smoking_composite = dplyr::case_when(
    ## if self-report, yes
    m_enroll_smoke == 1 ~ 1, 
    ## if self-report no or no report but cotinine == yes, yes
    (m_enroll_smoke == 0 | is.na(m_enroll_smoke) == TRUE) & cotinine_ever_yes == 1 ~ 1, 
    ## if self-report no and cotinine == no or cotinine is NA, no
    m_enroll_smoke == 0 & (is.na(cotinine_ever_yes) == TRUE | cotinine_ever_yes == 0) ~ 0, 
    ## else, everything must be NA, so NA
    is.na(m_enroll_smoke) == TRUE & (is.na(cotinine_ever_yes) == TRUE | cotinine_ever_yes == 0) ~ 8888
    ) |> na_if(8888)) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(smoking_composite) == FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(m_enroll_income) == FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(prepreg_bmi) == FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(m_age_birth) == FALSE)

## this is the grouping variable for supplementary table 1
p0047_candle$included <- dplyr::if_else(p0047_candle$pathways_id %in% covar$pathways_id, 1, 0)
```

First, let's make a table to compare covariates. 

For the supplementary table, let's test for differences between the  spontaneous births and the other CANDLE participants. 

```{r, results='asis'}
tabSup1data <- p0047_candle |>
  dplyr::left_join(miRNA_batches, by = join_by(pathways_id)) |>
  ## add in the miRNA batch; use left join to only match filtered data
  dplyr::left_join(p0109_data |> 
                     dplyr::select(pathways_id, zavg5_us_doc_dob_wght, cotinine_ever_yes) |> 
                     na.omit()) |>
   dplyr::mutate(smoking_composite = dplyr::case_when(
    ## if self-report, yes
    m_enroll_smoke == 1 ~ 1, 
    ## if self-report no or no report but cotinine == yes, yes
    (m_enroll_smoke == 0 | is.na(m_enroll_smoke) == TRUE) & cotinine_ever_yes == 1 ~ 1, 
    ## if self-report no and cotinine == no or cotinine is NA, no
    m_enroll_smoke == 0 & (is.na(cotinine_ever_yes) == TRUE | cotinine_ever_yes == 0) ~ 0, 
    ## else, everything must be NA, so NA
    is.na(m_enroll_smoke) == TRUE & (is.na(cotinine_ever_yes) == TRUE | cotinine_ever_yes == 0) ~ 8888
    ) |> na_if(8888)) |>
  within({
    m_enroll_educ <- factor(m_enroll_educ, labels =  c("<HS", "HS graduate/GED", "Technical school", "College degree", "Grad/Professional degree"))
    m_race <- factor(m_race, labels = c("Black/African American", "White", "Asian",
                                        "American Indian/Alaska Native", 
                                        "Native Hawaiian/Other Pacific Islander",
                                        "Other", "Multiple race"))
    c_sex <- factor(c_sex, labels = c("Male", "Female"))
    labor_type <- factor(labor_type, labels = c("Spontaneous", "Spontaneous, augmented", "Induced", "No labor"))
    del_method <- factor(del_method, labels = c("Vaginal", "C-section"))
    m_enroll_smoke <- factor(m_enroll_smoke, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    m_enroll_alc <- factor(m_enroll_alc, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    m_enroll_income <- ordered(m_enroll_income, labels = c("$0-4999", "$5000-9999", "$10000-14999",
                                                          "$15000-19999", "$20000-24999",
                                                          "$25000-34999", "$35000-44999",
                                                          "$45000-54999", "$55000-64999",
                                                          "$65000-74999", "$75000 or over"))
    preter_prior_yn <- factor(preterm_prior_yn, labels = c("No prior PTB", "At least 1 prior PTB"))
    # mir_batch <- factor(mir_batch)
    
    ## regen bmi because weirdly lots of NAs despite the complete underlying variables
    prepreg_bmi <- prepreg_weight_kg /((m_height_cm/100)^2) 
    
    ## preterm or not
    ptb <- factor(ptrm_currpreg, labels = c("Term", "Preterm"))
    smoking_composite <- factor(smoking_composite, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  })

labels(tabSup1data) <- c(
 m_age_birth = "Maternal age at birth",
 prepreg_bmi = "Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI",
 m_enroll_educ = "Maternal education",
 m_enroll_income = "Income",
 m_race = "Maternal race",
 m_enroll_smoke = "Maternal smoking status",
 m_enroll_alc = "Maternal alcohol use",
 c_sex = "Fetal sex",
 labor_type = "Labor type",
 del_method = "Delivery method",
 livebirths = "Total live births",
 mir_batch = "miRNA-seq batch"
 )

tabSup1 <- tableby(included ~ m_age_birth +
                       prepreg_bmi +
                       m_enroll_educ +
                       m_enroll_income +
                       m_race +
                  smoking_composite + 
                  m_enroll_alc +
                       c_sex +
                       labor_type +
                       del_method +
                    ptb,
                 data = tabSup1data, 
                 numeric.test = "anova", cat.test = "chisq",
                 numeric.stats = c("meansd", "medianq1q3", "Nmiss"),
                 cat.stats = c("countpct", "Nmiss"),
                 stats.labels = list(Nmiss = "Missing"))

summary(tabSup1) 
```

```{r}
       data = tabSup1data,

rstatix::levene_test(prepreg_bmi ~ factor(included), data = tabSup1data, center = "mean")

t.test(prepreg_bmi ~ included, 
       data = tabSup1data,
       alternative = "two.sided", var.equal = TRUE)
```

Let's also look at the samples included in the network. Recall that this table is the the cleaning sequencing data file for network generation. We can pull these together to make the final supplementary table.

```{r}
covar <- within(covar, {
  mir_batch <- factor(mir_batch)
  m_enroll_educ <- factor(m_enroll_educ, labels =  c("<HS", "HS graduate/GED", "Technical school", "College degree", "Grad/Professional degree"))
  m_race <- factor(m_race, labels = c("Black/African American", "White", "Asian", "Other", "Multiple race"))
  c_sex <- factor(c_sex, labels = c("Male", "Female"))

  del_method <- factor(del_method, labels = c("Vaginal", "C-section"))
  m_enroll_smoke <- factor(m_enroll_smoke, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  smoking_composite <- factor(smoking_composite, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  m_enroll_alc <- factor(m_enroll_alc, labels = c("No", "Yes"))
  m_enroll_income <- ordered(m_enroll_income, labels = c("$0-4999", "$5000-9999", "$10000-14999",
                                                        "$15000-19999", "$20000-24999",
                                                        "$25000-34999", "$35000-44999",
                                                        "$45000-54999", "$55000-64999",
```

## MicroRNA Cleaning

Here, I am adapting code from Alison's CRH analysis in CANDLE (CRH_PreliminaryDataPreprocessing_3102023.Rmd) and her miRNA cleaning.

```{r}
Counts <- all_mirs[, covar$pathways_id]

## make an annotation file
rownames(Counts) <- all_mirs$Name

annot <- tibble(name = all_mirs$Name, 
                miRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "miR"), 1, 0),
                piRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "piR"), 1, 0)) |>
  ## the let miRNAs aren't labled, so let's fix that
  dplyr::mutate(miRNA = dplyr::if_else(str_detect(all_mirs$Name, "let"), 1, miRNA))

# rownames(annot) <- annot$name

## sanity check 
table(annot$miRNA, annot$piRNA)

print("Original")
print(dim(Counts)[1])
print(dim(annot)[1])

## there are some NAs that need to be turned to 1s since cpm cannot handle them
Counts[is.na(Counts)] <- 0

## UPDATE 20240807
## remove piRNAs
annot <- annot[annot$piRNA != 1, ]
Counts <- Counts[annot$name, ]

## Get CPM & Log Transform
cpm <- cpm(Counts, log = TRUE)

## filter based on low expression
keep <- rowMeans(cpm) > 0
summary(keep)

cpm_filt <- cpm[keep, ]
annot <- annot[keep, ]
counts_filt <- Counts[keep, ]

print("Filtering")
print(dim(cpm_filt)[1])
print(dim(annot)[1])
print(dim(counts_filt)[1])

plot(density(cpm), main="Before Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(density(cpm_filt), main="After Filtering")
abline(v = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

Y <- DGEList(counts = counts_filt)

boxplot(Y$counts[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm[, 1:10])
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])
Y <- calcNormFactors(Y, method = "TMM") # This is the Default Method
boxplot(cpm(Y, log = T)[, 1:10])

### Calculate CPM
CPM <- cpm(Y, log = T)

rownames(CPM) <- rownames(counts_filt)

sncRNA <- Y
```

## Differential Expression Analysis

### Preterm birth in overall analysis

First, generate the primary model.

```{r}
mod <- with(covar, 
            model.matrix(~ ptb +
                           ## confounders
                           m_race + 
                           m_enroll_income +
                           prepreg_bmi +
                           m_enroll_educ +
                           m_age_birth +
                           smoking_composite +
                           m_enroll_alc +
                           labor_type +
                           ## precision variables
                           mir_batch +
                           c_sex
                          ))
```

Now, conduct limma-voom.

```{r}
v <- voom(sncRNA, mod, plot = TRUE) 
designMatrix <- v$design
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(v, designMatrix))
fit <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number=dim(fit)[1], adjust.method = "BH") #Coefficent 2 is PTB

hist(fit$P.Value, breaks = 20, main = "Spontaneous Preterm Birth")
abline(h = 557/20)

Results <- fit

table(Results$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
```

### Gestational age (in WEEKS) overall analysis

First, generate the secondary model.

```{r}
mod_ga_wk <- with(covar |>
                    dplyr::mutate(
                      ga = birth_gestage/7
                    ), 
            model.matrix(~ ga +
                           ## confounders
                           m_race + 
                           m_enroll_income +
                           prepreg_bmi +
                           m_enroll_educ +
                           m_age_birth +
                           smoking_composite +
                           m_enroll_alc +
                           labor_type +
                           ## precision variables
                           mir_batch + 
                           c_sex
                          ))
```

Now, conduct limma-voom. Note that above we are comparing PTB to term birth (control/reference), but here, gestational age is a continuous variable. So we would expect these results to be **opposite** in direction.

```{r}
v <- voom(sncRNA, mod_ga_wk, plot=TRUE) 
designMatrix <- v$design
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(v, designMatrix))
fit <- topTable(fit, coef = 2, number=dim(fit)[1], adjust.method = "BH") ## Coefficent 2 is GA at birth

hist(fit$P.Value, breaks = 20, main = "Gestational Length (Weeks)")
abline(h = 557/20)

Results_GA_WK <-fit
Results_GA_WK$pct_change <- 100*(2^Results_GA_WK$logFC-1)

table(Results_GA_WK$adj.P.Val < 0.05)
```

### MiRNA precursors and families

How many miRNA precursors are represented here?

```{r}
coordinates <- ape::read.gff(here::here("network_construction", "mirbase", "hsa.gff3")) |>
  ## want to get attributes out, so make attributes a list
  dplyr::mutate(attributes_as_list = base::strsplit(attributes, ";")) |>
  ## pull the attributes out into individual rows
  tidyr::unnest_longer(attributes_as_list) |>
  ## separate the attribute name from the value
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cols = attributes_as_list, delim = "=",
                       names = c("attribute", "value")) |>
  ## pivot wider so there is one row per observation
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 1:9, names_from = attribute, values_from = value) |>
  ## remove null columns
  dplyr::select(-c(source, score, phase, attributes)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Name %in% rownames(Results)[Results$adj.P.Val<0.05])

coordinates |>
  dplyr::pull(Derives_from) |>
  unique() |>
  length()

miR_family <- read_tsv(here::here("network_construction", "TargetScan", "miR_Family_Info.txt")) |> 
  dplyr::filter(`Species ID` == 9606) |>
  dplyr::filter(`MiRBase ID` %in% rownames(Results)[Results$adj.P.Val<0.05])

miR_family |>
  # dplyr::pull(`miR family`) |>
  dplyr::pull(`Seed+m8`) |>
  unique() |>
  length()
```

## Interpretation

Read in the list of targets. This is our edge list for the full miRNA--mRNA network. 

```{r}
## read data
## mRNA targets of miRNA:
## first, we found all predicted using TargetScan
## then, pruned based on negative spearman correlations
targets <- read_csv(here::here("network_construction", "allPairs_edges_20240719.csv"))

## read gene annotation file
annotation <- read_csv(here::here("network_construction", "intermediateData", "annotation_gencode_v33_proteincoding.csv")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(ensembl_gene_id = gsub("\\..*", "", ensembl_gene_id_version))

## placenta specific miRNAs
miRNA_clusters <- read_csv(here::here("network_construction", "intermediateData", "placenta_specific_miRNA_clusters_updated.csv"))
```

We also need our list of significant mRNA and miRNA related to sPTB. 
For now, let's focus on just the preterm birth vs term birth comparisons. 

```{r}
## DEGs from sPTB paper
apaquette2023_sPTB_DEG <- readxl::read_excel("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/nutrientCofactors/apaquette2023_sPTB_DEG.xlsx",
                                             skip = 1)

colnames(apaquette2023_sPTB_DEG) <- c("gene_name", "logFC_ptb", "FDR_ptb", "logFC_eptb", "FDR_eptb", "logFC_lptb", "FDR_lptb", "priorLit_pereyra2019", "priorLit_brockway2019", "priorLit_paquette2018")

## primarily, interested in the DEGs for preterm vs term births
ptb_mRNAs <- apaquette2023_sPTB_DEG |> dplyr::filter(is.na(logFC_ptb) == FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::select(gene_name, logFC = logFC_ptb, FDR = FDR_ptb) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(annotation |> 
                      dplyr::select(gene_name, hgnc_id, ensembl_gene_id) |>
                      dplyr::distinct()) 

ptb_sncRNAs <- Results |>
  dplyr::as_tibble(rownames = pkgconfig::get_config("tibble::rownames", "Name")) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol = Name, logFC, FDR = adj.P.Val) |>
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) 

ga_sncRNAs <- Results_GA_WK |>
  dplyr::as_tibble(rownames = pkgconfig::get_config("tibble::rownames", "Name")) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol = Name, logFC, FDR = adj.P.Val) |>
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) 

rm(apaquette2023_sPTB_DEG)
```

Generate the volcano plot

```{r, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4}
differential_colors <- scico::scico(11, palette = "bam")

Results |>
  dplyr::as_tibble(rownames = pkgconfig::get_config("tibble::rownames", "Name")) |>
  ## make variables for plotting
  dplyr::mutate(isSig = dplyr::if_else(adj.P.Val < 0.05, 1, 0),
                direction = dplyr::case_when(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0 ~ "down",
                                             adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0 ~ "up",
                                             adj.P.Val >= 0.05 ~ "none" ) |>
                  factor(levels = c("down", "none", "up")),
                point_name = dplyr::if_else(adj.P.Val < 0.05, Name, "NA")
                )|>
  dplyr::left_join(miRNA_clusters) |>
  ## volcano plot
  ggplot(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
  ## lines for pvalues
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05/557), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey80") +
  ## labels 
  labs(y = "-log~10~(*P*)") +
  ## points
  ## first, highlight the C14MC points and let-7 family
  geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, cluster == "C14MC" & isSig == 1), 
             shape = 16, 
             # color = "turquoise3",
             color = "turquoise3",
             size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(.x, stringr::str_detect(point_name, "let-7") == TRUE), 
             shape = 16, 
             # color = "turquoise3",
             color = "brown2",
             size = 2) +
  ## all other points
  geom_point(shape = 21, 
             color = "#FFFFFF00", 
             size = 1,
             aes(fill = direction)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, isSig == 1), 
                  size = 3, 
                  na.rm = TRUE,
                  seed = 2024,
                  segment.alpha = 0.4,
                  max.overlaps = 20,
                  aes(color = direction, 
                      label = point_name), 
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0) +
  ## scales
  scale_color_manual(values = c(differential_colors[1],  differential_colors[11])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(differential_colors[3], "grey", differential_colors[9])) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 23, 24, 25)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())

ggsave(filename = here::here("sptb_analysis", "output", "volcano_plot.pdf"), 
       width = 6.5, height = 4, units = "in")
```

Merge all of the data together.

```{r}
all_mir_of_interest <- c(ga_sncRNAs |> dplyr::pull(gene_symbol), 
                         ptb_sncRNAs |> dplyr::pull(gene_symbol)) |>
  unique()

## summarize
regulon_counts <- targets |>
  dplyr::group_by(miRNA) |>
  dplyr::select(miRNA) |>
  count() |>
  dplyr::rename(target_counts = n)

regulon_counts_sptb <- targets |>
  dplyr::filter(mRNA_target %in% ptb_mRNAs$ensembl_gene_id) |>
  dplyr::group_by(miRNA) |>
  dplyr::select(miRNA) |>
  count() |>
  dplyr::rename(sptb_target_counts = n)

regulon_table <- dplyr::full_join(regulon_counts, regulon_counts_sptb) 

results_table2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  Results |>
    dplyr::as_tibble(rownames = pkgconfig::get_config("tibble::rownames", "Name")) |>
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol = Name, logFC, FDR = adj.P.Val) |>
    dplyr::mutate(exposure = "sPTB"),
  
  Results_GA_WK |>
    dplyr::as_tibble(rownames = pkgconfig::get_config("tibble::rownames", "Name")) |>
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol = Name, logFC, FDR = adj.P.Val) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(exposure = "GA")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(miRNA = gene_symbol, exposure, logFC, FDR) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = miRNA, 
                     names_from = exposure, 
                     values_from = logFC:FDR, 
                     names_vary = "slowest") |>
  dplyr::left_join(regulon_table) |>
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% all_mir_of_interest) |>
  dplyr::mutate(miRNA = factor(miRNA, levels = c(sptb_mir[!sptb_mir %in% ga_mir], 
                                                 sptb_mir[sptb_mir %in% ga_mir], 
                                                 ga_mir[!ga_mir %in% sptb_mir]))) |>
  dplyr::arrange(miRNA) 

write_csv(results_table2, file = here::here("sptb_analysis", "output", "results_table2_DEmiR_regulons_20260821.csv"))

results_table2 |>
  kable() |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
```

## Interpretation: Pathway ORA

```{r}
enriched_pathways <- read_csv(here::here("network_construction", "interpretation", "complete_pathway_enrichment_results.csv"))

enriched_pathways |>
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% all_mir_of_interest & FDR < 0.05) |>

  kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, target = 1)
```

Only 1 of the sPTB-associated miRNA has targets that are enriched for KEGG pathways at the FDR<0.05 level.

We can also conduct pathway ORA on the whole set of sPTB genes targeted by the sPTB-associated miRNAs. 

```{r}
## take all up or down regulated miRNA in sPTB
## group all sPTB-associated mRNA regardless of directionality
mir_targets_sptb_down <- targets |>
  ## only downregulated miRNA
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% ptb_sncRNAs[ptb_sncRNAs$logFC < 0, ]$gene_symbol) |>
  ## only sptb associated mRNA
  dplyr::filter(mRNA_target %in% unique(ptb_mRNAs$ensembl_gene_id)) |>
  dplyr::pull(mRNA_target) |>
  unique()

length(mir_targets_sptb_down)

mir_targets_sptb_up <- targets |>
  ## only UP regulated miRNA
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% ptb_sncRNAs[ptb_sncRNAs$logFC > 0, ]$gene_symbol) |>
  ## only sptb associated mRNA
  dplyr::filter(mRNA_target %in% unique(ptb_mRNAs$ensembl_gene_id)) |>
  dplyr::pull(mRNA_target) |>
  unique()

length(mir_targets_sptb_up)
```

First, prepare KEGG Database

```{r}
load(here::here("KEGG_pathways", "KEGG_database_20240719.Rds"))
```

Second, get NCBI (Entrez) gene IDs using our annotation file.

```{r}
entrez <- read_tsv("network_construction", "gencode_v33", "gencode.v33.metadata.EntrezGene", 
                   col_names = c("ensembl_transcript_id_version", "ncbi_gene_id"))

annot_entrez <- dplyr::inner_join(annotation |>
                                   dplyr::mutate(ensembl_gene_id = gsub("\\..*", "", 
                                                                        ensembl_gene_id_version)) |>
                                    ## make sure to limit the background 
                                    ## to the targets in the network
                                   dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% targets$mRNA_target), 
                                 entrez |>
                                   dplyr::select(ensembl_transcript_id_version, ncbi_gene_id) |>
                                   na.omit() |>
                                   dplyr::distinct(),
                                 by = join_by(ensembl_transcript_id_version)) |>
  dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, ncbi_gene_id, gene_name) |>
  dplyr::distinct()
```

Now, let's conduct the ORA. We are lumping together all of the sPTB-associated targets of the down-regulated miRNA in sPTB. We are then doing the same thing with all the sPTB-associated targets of the up-regulated miRNAs. 

```{r}
limited_pathways <- keggs |>
  dplyr::filter(PathwayID %in% keggmapper$V1) 

### DOWN REGULATED
## setup
moduleGenes <- mir_targets_sptb_down
  
## select module genes as moduleGeneSet
moduleGeneSet <- annot_entrez |>
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% moduleGenes)
  
## test if the module geneset 
down_targets_enriched <- limma::kegga(moduleGeneSet$ncbi_gene_id, 
                                      species = "Hs",
                                      universe = annot_entrez$ncbi_gene_id,
                                      gene.pathway = limited_pathways,
                                      pathway.names = keggmapper,
                                      FDR = 0.05,
                                      restrict.universe = TRUE)
  
down_targets_enriched$FDR <- p.adjust(down_targets_enriched$P.DE, method = "BH")

down_targets_enriched |>
  dplyr::arrange(P.DE) |>
  dplyr::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1) |>
  kable() |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling() |>
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(1, target = 1)

### UP REGULATED
## setup
moduleGenes <- mir_targets_sptb_up
  
## select module genes as moduleGeneSet
moduleGeneSet <- annot_entrez |>
  dplyr::filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% moduleGenes)
  
## test if the module geneset 
up_targets_enriched <- limma::kegga(moduleGeneSet$ncbi_gene_id, 
                                      species = "Hs",
                                      universe = annot_entrez$ncbi_gene_id,
                                      gene.pathway = limited_pathways,
                                      pathway.names = keggmapper,
                                      FDR = 0.05,
                                      restrict.universe = TRUE)
  
up_targets_enriched$FDR <- p.adjust(up_targets_enriched$P.DE, method = "BH")

up_targets_enriched |>
  dplyr::arrange(P.DE) |>
  dplyr::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1) |>
  kable() |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling() |>
  kableExtra::collapse_rows(1, target = 1)
```

When we look at the down-regulated targets, these target genes are involved in immune related-processes. (Note to self for the future vitamin D analysis: some of these are linked to vitamin D, too). The up-regulated genes are not significantly associated with any pathways.

```{r fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
pathway_groups <- readxl::read_excel("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/kegg_pathway_groups.xlsx")

path_Data <- up_targets_enriched |>
  dplyr::arrange(P.DE) |>
  dplyr::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(magnitude = -log(P.DE), 
                FDR_cat = factor(dplyr::if_else(FDR<0.05, 0, 1)),
                pathway_name = str_replace_all(Pathway, "_", " ")) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(pathway_groups, by = join_by(pathway_name == `Pathway Name`)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(`Super Group`, Subgroup) 

pathway_plot <- ggplot(path_Data,
                       aes(x = factor(Subgroup),
                           y = pathway_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = FDR_cat, size = magnitude),
             fill = "white", color = differential_colors[2]) +
  ylab("") +
  xlab("") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 21), name = "FDR Threshold",
                     labels = c("FDR<0.05", "FDR<0.1")) +
  scale_size(name = "-log(p)", guide = "none") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right", 
        legend.direction = "vertical")

pathway_plot

ggsave(filename = here::here("sptb_analysis", "output", "upreg_miRNA_target_pathways.pdf"), width = 5, height = 4)
```

## Up- vs down-regulated miRNA and the sPTB subnetwork

First, we need the TRN to get the IDs for the transcription factors, because we want to identify them in the figures.

```{r}
TRNModel <-  read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/mparenti/resources/Placental_Gene_TF_Associations.csv")
TRNModel$targetGene <- as.character(TRNModel$targetGene)
TRNModel$TF <- as.character(TRNModel$TF)
```

Start with the up-regulated miRNA.

```{r}
sptb_up_network <- targets |>
  dplyr::filter(miRNA %in% ptb_sncRNAs[ptb_sncRNAs$logFC>0, ]$gene_symbol) |>
  dplyr::filter(mRNA_target %in% unique(ptb_mRNAs$ensembl_gene_id))

sptb_up_network$miRNA |> unique() |> length()
sptb_up_network$mRNA_target |> unique() |> length()

unweighted_graph <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(el = sptb_up_network |> dplyr::select(all_of(c("miRNA", "mRNA_target"))) |> as.matrix(), 
                      directed = TRUE) 
## make it bipartite
## make bipartite by making a vector of types
named_types <- dplyr::if_else(V(unweighted_graph)$name %in% sptb_up_network$miRNA, 0, 1)
names(named_types) <- V(unweighted_graph)$name

V(unweighted_graph)$type <- named_types

is_bipartite(unweighted_graph)

## add weights: must be positive for layout_with_fr and layout_with_kk
E(unweighted_graph)$weight <- abs(sptb_up_network$cor)

weights <- sptb_up_network |>
  dplyr::select(c(from = miRNA, to = mRNA_target, cor))

set.seed(2024)

node_layout <- igraph::layout_with_fr(unweighted_graph) |> #can also try layout_with_dh(); layout_with_graphopt
  as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::mutate(node = V(unweighted_graph)$name) |>
  dplyr::mutate(is_miRNA = factor(dplyr::if_else(node %in% unique(ptb_sncRNAs$gene_symbol), "miRNA", "target"))) |>
  ## make a variables for effectsize
  dplyr::left_join(ptb_sncRNAs |> 
                     dplyr::select(node = gene_symbol, logFC_miRNA = logFC,
                                   FDR_miRNA = FDR)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(ptb_mRNAs |> 
                     dplyr::select(node = ensembl_gene_id, gene_name, 
                                   logFC_mRNA = logFC,
                                   FDR_mRNA = FDR)) |>
  ## pull the logFC and FDR for each partition into a single variable
  dplyr::mutate(logFC = dplyr::case_when(is_miRNA == "miRNA" & is.na(logFC_miRNA) == FALSE ~ logFC_miRNA,
                                         is_miRNA == "target" & is.na(logFC_mRNA) == FALSE ~ logFC_mRNA,
                                         is_miRNA == "target" & is.na(logFC_mRNA) == TRUE ~ NA),
                FDR = dplyr::case_when(is_miRNA == "miRNA" & is.na(FDR_miRNA) == FALSE ~ FDR_miRNA,
                                       is_miRNA == "target" & is.na(FDR_mRNA) == FALSE ~ FDR_mRNA,
                                       is_miRNA == "target" & is.na(FDR_mRNA) == TRUE ~ NA)) |>
  ## make a categorical version in case we need to have just up/down by partition
  dplyr::mutate(logFC_cat = dplyr::case_when(is.na(logFC) == FALSE & logFC<0 ~ "down", 
                                             is.na(logFC) == FALSE & logFC>0 ~ "up",
                                             is.na(logFC) == TRUE ~ "none") |>
                  factor(levels = c("up", "down", "none"))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ## make a categorical version in case we need to have just up/down by partition
    type_logFC = factor(interaction(logFC_cat, is_miRNA)),
    ## make variable so we can just lable miRNAs
    only_miRNA_label = dplyr::if_else(is_miRNA == "miRNA", str_replace(node, "hsa-", ""), "."),
    ## make a variable so we can ID "placenta enhanced" genes from HPA
    placenta_specific = dplyr::if_else(is_miRNA == "target" & node %in% placenta_specific$Ensembl, 1, 0) |> 
                  factor(),
    ## make variable so we can label C14MC microRNA
    is_C14MC = factor(dplyr::if_else(node %in% miRNA_clusters[miRNA_clusters$cluster == "C14MC", ]$Name, 1, 0)),
    ## make variable so we can lable let-7 family
    is_let7 = factor(dplyr::if_else(stringr::str_detect(node, "let-7"), 1, 0))
                ) |>
  ## generate a variable for "type" to split targets into TFs and other protein coding genes
  dplyr::mutate(type = dplyr::case_when(is_miRNA == "miRNA" ~ "miRNA",
                                        is_miRNA == "target" & gene_name %in% TRNModel$TF ~ "TF",
                                        is_miRNA == "target" & !gene_name %in% TRNModel$TF ~ "gene") |>
                  factor(levels = c("miRNA", "TF", "gene")), 
                mir_family = dplyr::case_when(is_miRNA == "miRNA" & is_C14MC == "1" ~ "C14MC",
                                              is_miRNA == "miRNA" & is_let7 == "1" ~ "let-7",
                                              is_miRNA == "miRNA" & is_C14MC == "0" & is_let7 == "0" ~ "other miRNA", 
                                              is_miRNA != "miRNA" ~ "target gene") |> factor()) |>
  ## make some more variables now that we have type, label_all, label_miRNA_TFs
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_all = dplyr::if_else(is_miRNA == "miRNA", str_replace(node, "hsa-", ""), gene_name),
    label_miRNA_TFs = dplyr::case_when(type == "miRNA" ~ str_replace(node, "hsa-", ""), 
                                       type == "TF" ~ gene_name,
                                       type == "target" ~ "."),
    label_TFs = dplyr::if_else(type == "TF", gene_name, ".")
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

edges_layout <- igraph::as_data_frame(unweighted_graph)
edges_layout$from.x <- node_layout$V1[match(edges_layout$from, node_layout$node)]  #  match the from locations from the node data.frame we previously connected
edges_layout$from.y <- node_layout$V2[match(edges_layout$from, node_layout$node)]
edges_layout$to.x <- node_layout$V1[match(edges_layout$to, node_layout$node)]  #  match the to locations from the node data.frame we previously connected
edges_layout$to.y <- node_layout$V2[match(edges_layout$to, node_layout$node)]

weighted_graph <- dplyr::left_join(edges_layout, weights, by = join_by(from, to))
```

Plot the up-regulated miRNA network (targeting predominately down-regulated targets).

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=10}
upreg_mir_subnetwork <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = weighted_graph,
               aes(x = from.x, 
                   xend = to.x, 
                   y = from.y, 
                   yend = to.y, 
                   alpha = cor), 
               linewidth = .5,
               lineend = "square",
               linejoin = "mitre",
               color = "gray30",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), 
                             type = "closed")) + ## arrow
  ## now, giant points for outlines for C14MC and let-7 family
  geom_point(data = node_layout |> 
               ## just let-7 family
               dplyr::filter(is_let7 == "1"), 
             aes(x = V1, y = V2, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)*8), 
             color = "brown2", 
             shape = 18) + 
  geom_point(data = node_layout |> 
               ## just let-7 family
               dplyr::filter(is_C14MC == "1"), 
             aes(x = V1, y = V2,  
                 size = -log10(FDR)*8), 
             color = "turquoise3",
             shape = 18) + 
  ## now, all the nodes
  geom_point(data = node_layout |> 
               ## first arrange so logFC_cat == "none" on top
               dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC_cat)) |>
               ## arrange to plot miRNA at the end
               dplyr::arrange(desc(type)), 
             aes(x = V1, y = V2, fill = logFC, 
                 shape = type, size = -log10(FDR)),
             color = "white") + 
  ## now, print miRNA lables
  geom_text_repel(data = node_layout |> dplyr::filter(only_miRNA_label != "."),
                  aes(x = V1, 
                      y = V2, 
                      label = only_miRNA_label), 
                  size = 4,
                  bg.color = "white", ## text outline color
                  bg.r = .15) + # add the name
  ## print only TFS
  geom_text_repel(data = node_layout |> dplyr::filter(label_TFs != "."),
                  aes(x = V1, y = V2, label = label_TFs),
                  size = 2,
                  bg.color = "white", ## text outline color
                  bg.r = .15) + # add the name
  ## Print all genes
  # geom_text_repel(data = node_layout |> dplyr::filter(is.na(gene_name) != TRUE),
  #                 aes(x = V1, y = V2, label = gene_name), 
  #                 size = 3.5,
  #                 bg.color = "white", ## text outline color
  #                 bg.r = .15) + # add the name
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.2, 1), transform = "reverse", # n.breaks = 3,
              name = "Edge strength\n(rho)") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = scico::scico(11, palette = "bam"),
                       limits = c(-1.7, 1.7), 
                       name = "Association with\nsPTB (logFC)") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(23, 24, 21), name = "Type") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "FDR", breaks = c(2,3, 4),
                        labels = c("0.01", "0.001", "0.0001"),
                        range = c(1, 5)) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#132330", size = 3))) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#132330", shape = 21))) +
  
  ## get rid of some of the padding/whitespace
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +  # use the ggplot black and white theme
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # remove x-axis text
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # remove y-axis text
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),   # remove axis ticks
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), # remove x-axis labels
    axis.title.y = element_blank(), # remove y-axis labels
    # panel.background = element_blank(), 
    panel.border = element_blank(), 
    # plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #remove major-grid labels
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()  #remove minor-grid labels
    )
```

```{r fig.width = 6.5, fig.height=3.5}
seahorse_ocr <- read_csv("inhibition_seahorse/oxphos_experiment_2_ocr_parameter_data_long.csv")

## first, get parameters from Evan's file

stats_df <- tibble(
  parameter = c("ATP-linked\nRespiration", "ATP-linked\nRespiration", "Basal\nRespiration"),
  xmin = c("Negative\nControl", "Negative\nControl", "Negative\nControl"),
  xmax = c("miR-376c-3p", "miR-377-3p", "miR-377-3p"),
  label = c("list(~italic(P) == 0.035)", "list(~italic(P) == 0.027)", "list(~italic(P) == 0.035)"),
  y.position = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.8)
)

seahorse_ocr |>
  dplyr::filter(parameter %in% c("ATP linked respiration", "basal respiration")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    parameter = dplyr::replace_values(
      parameter,
      "ATP linked respiration" ~ "ATP-linked\nRespiration", 
      "basal respiration" ~ "Basal\nRespiration"
      ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Basal\nRespiration", "ATP-linked\nRespiration")),
    mir_name = dplyr::if_else(mir_name == "Negative Control",
                              "Negative\nControl", 
                              mir_name) |>
      factor(levels = c("Negative\nControl", "miR-376c-3p", "miR-377-3p", "miR-381-3p"))
    ) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mir_name, 
      y = resp_value) +
  ## axis
  ylab("Oxygen Consumption Rate\n(pmol/min/ug protein)") +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ## statistics + data
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "bar", 
               aes(fill = mir_name, 
                   color = mir_name)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_sdl", fun.args = list(mult = 1), 
               geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2,
               linewidth = 1,
               aes(color = mir_name)) +
   geom_jitter(#fill = "#00000099",
     #aes(fill = mir_name), 
              height = 0, ## CRTICAL so the rate is correct
              width = 0.2, ## allows some horizontal movement
              color = "black", 
              alpha = 0.7,
              shape = 16, 
              size = 2) +
  ## add some padding for the annotation
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  ## stats annotation
  ggpubr::geom_bracket(
    data = stats_df, 
    aes(
      xmin = xmin, 
      xmax = xmax, 
      label = label, 
      y.position = y.position
    ), 
    label.size = 3, 
    type = "expression") +
  ## themes + scales
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_markdown(),
    axis.title = element_markdown(),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(parameter), scale = "free_y")
```
